_fixture_note: Deliberately degenerate: all four polygonCorners are collinear (they lie on the line z=0), so the shoelace formula resolves this to a 0 m2 outline. Real RoomPlan output would not produce this, but a corrupted or malicious capture payload could — this fixture exists to prove the adapter rejects it instead of silently returning a 'Room 1' with floor_area_m2: 0 and coverage.usable: true, which is what happened before RoomPlanSimulatorAdapter::MIN_POLYGON_AREA_M2 was added. See RoomPlanSimulatorAdapter.php doc comment.
